title: Alo's Script -  (Keyless)
script:
-- Made by Alo's [Have Fun] V1
-- Multi-Spot Teleport + Noclip + ESP for Don't Let Him In
-- Full English, Keyless, Optimized (No Lag)

repeat wait() until game:IsLoaded()

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local plr = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getChar()
    return plr.Character or plr.CharacterAdded:Wait()
end

local function getRoot()
    local c = getChar()
    return c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

-- SPOT DATABASE
local SPOTS = {
    houseLarge = { name = "Safe Spot [LARGE]", path = "Workspace.House.Second Floor.Structure.MasterScalePartition.PlasterPartition", game = "The House" },
    houseSafe = { name = "Lazy Spot [He Can See You but he cant kill you]", path = "Workspace.House.Second Floor.Rooms.Bathroom2.Objects.BathAndShower.Bathtub", game = "The House" },
    lazySpot2 = { name = "Lazy Spot 2 [Same Thing]", path = "Workspace.House.Areas.Bathroom1.Objects.Shower.Bathtub", game = "The House" },
    snowMini = { name = "Safe Spot [Mini but safe]", path = "Workspace.House.Areas.LodgeArt.Snowden.07_Hearth.ChimneyShaft", game = "Snowbound" },
    snowWIP = { name = "Safe Spot (WIP)", path = nil, game = "Snowbound" },
    stormIron = { name = "Safe spot (Super super lazy searching best spot..)", path = "Workspace.House.Shell.BuiltInFurniture.GroundFloor.Kitchen.Iron.iron", game = "StormChast" },
    stormMahog = { name = "Safe Spot (Idk)", path = "Workspace.House.Shell.GrandStaircase.GroundFloor.GrandHall.Mahog.mahog", game = "StormChast" }
}

local noclipActive = true
local espActive = false
local brightActive = false
local fogErased = false

local function notif(title, text)
    game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = title, Text = text, Duration = 3
    })
end

local function noclip()
    if noclipActive then
        local c = getChar()
        for _, v in pairs(c:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanCollide = false end
        end
    end
end

local function findPartByName(name)
    for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.Name == name then return obj end
    end
    return nil
end

local function getPartFromPath(path)
    if not path then return nil end
    local parts = string.split(path, ".")
    local current = game
    for _, partName in pairs(parts) do
        if current then current = current:FindFirstChild(partName) end
    end
    if current and current:IsA("BasePart") then return current end
    return findPartByName(parts[#parts])
end

local function teleportToSpot(spotKey)
    local spot = SPOTS[spotKey]
    if not spot then return end
    if not spot.path then
        notif("By Alo's", spot.name .. " is still under construction!")
        return
    end
    local part = getPartFromPath(spot.path)
    if part then
        local root = getRoot()
        root.CFrame = part.CFrame
        notif("By Alo's", "Teleported to " .. spot.name .. "!")
    else
        notif("By Alo's", "Spot not found, This is for " .. spot.game .. " btw")
    end
end

-- GUI
local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "By_Alos"
gui.Parent = game.CoreGui

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 420)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -160, 0.5, -210)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 0, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
mainFrame.Active = true
mainFrame.Draggable = true
mainFrame.Parent = gui
mainFrame.Visible = true

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
title.Text = "By Alo's [Have Fun] V1"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50)
title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 0, 0)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 18
title.Parent = mainFrame

local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -35, 0, 5)
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 0, 0)
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.Parent = mainFrame

local menuFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
menuFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 80)
menuFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50)
menuFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
menuFrame.Parent = mainFrame

local function createMenuBtn(text, x, callback)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 35)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, 0)
    b.Text = text
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 12
    b.Parent = menuFrame
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(callback)
    return b
end

local houseBtn = createMenuBtn("The House", 0, function() end)
local snowBtn = createMenuBtn("Snowbound", 75, function() end)
local stormBtn = createMenuBtn("StormChast", 150, function() end)
local mainBtn2 = createMenuBtn("Main", 225, function() end)

-- KONTEN HOUSE
local houseContent = Instance.new("Frame")
houseContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 250)
houseContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 140)
houseContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
houseContent.Visible = false
houseContent.Parent = mainFrame

local function makeHouseBtn(text, y, key)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
    b.Text = text
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.TextWrapped = true
    b.Parent = houseContent
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToSpot(key) end)
end
makeHouseBtn("Safe Spot [LARGE]", 0, "houseLarge")
makeHouseBtn("Lazy Spot [He Can See You but he cant kill you]", 55, "houseSafe")
makeHouseBtn("Lazy Spot 2 [Same Thing]", 115, "lazySpot2")

-- KONTEN SNOWBOUND
local snowContent = Instance.new("Frame")
snowContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 250)
snowContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 140)
snowContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
snowContent.Visible = false
snowContent.Parent = mainFrame

local function makeSnowBtn(text, y, key)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
    b.Text = text
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.Parent = snowContent
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToSpot(key) end)
end
makeSnowBtn("Safe Spot [Mini but safe]", 0, "snowMini")
makeSnowBtn("Safe Spot (WIP)", 55, "snowWIP")

-- KONTEN STORMCHAST
local stormContent = Instance.new("Frame")
stormContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 250)
stormContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 140)
stormContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
stormContent.Visible = false
stormContent.Parent = mainFrame

local function makeStormBtn(text, y, key)
    local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
    b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 45)
    b.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, y)
    b.Text = text
    b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
    b.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
    b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    b.TextSize = 14
    b.TextWrapped = true
    b.Parent = stormContent
    b.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() teleportToSpot(key) end)
end
makeStormBtn("Safe spot (Super super lazy searching best spot..)", 0, "stormIron")
makeStormBtn("Safe Spot (Idk)", 55, "stormMahog")

-- KONTEN MAIN (FITUR BARU)
local mainContent = Instance.new("Frame")
mainContent.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 250)
mainContent.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 140)
mainContent.BackgroundTransparency = 1
mainContent.Visible = false
mainContent.Parent = mainFrame

local noclipBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
noclipBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
noclipBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: ON"
noclipBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
noclipBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
noclipBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
noclipBtn.TextSize = 14
noclipBtn.Parent = mainContent
noclipBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    noclipActive = not noclipActive
    noclipBtn.Text = "Noclip: " .. (noclipActive and "ON" or "OFF")
end)

local brightBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
brightBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
brightBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 45)
brightBtn.Text = "Bright: OFF"
brightBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
brightBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
brightBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
brightBtn.TextSize = 14
brightBtn.Parent = mainContent
brightBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    brightActive = not brightActive
    brightBtn.Text = "Bright: " .. (brightActive and "ON" or "OFF")
    if brightActive then
        Lighting.Brightness = 3
        Lighting.ClockTime = 12
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    else
        Lighting.Brightness = 1
        Lighting.ClockTime = 0
        Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    end
end)

local fogBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
fogBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
fogBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 90)
fogBtn.Text = "Erase FOG: OFF"
fogBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
fogBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
fogBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
fogBtn.TextSize = 14
fogBtn.Parent = mainContent
fogBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    fogErased = not fogErased
    fogBtn.Text = "Erase FOG: " .. (fogErased and "ON" or "OFF")
    if fogErased then
        Lighting.FogEnd = 100000
        Lighting.FogStart = 0
    else
        Lighting.FogEnd = 1000
        Lighting.FogStart = 0
    end
end)

local espBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
espBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
espBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 135)
espBtn.Text = "ESP Monster: OFF"
espBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 0, 0)
espBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
espBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
espBtn.TextSize = 14
espBtn.Parent = mainContent
espBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    espActive = not espActive
    espBtn.Text = "ESP Monster: " .. (espActive and "ON" or "OFF")
end)

local function showPage(page)
    houseContent.Visible = (page == "house")
    snowContent.Visible = (page == "snow")
    stormContent.Visible = (page == "storm")
    mainContent.Visible = (page == "main")
end

houseBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage("house") end)
snowBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage("snow") end)
stormBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage("storm") end)
mainBtn2.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() showPage("main") end)

-- ESP MONSTER (OPTIMIZED, NO LAG)
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if espActive then
        for _, obj in pairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("Model") and obj.Name == "Monster" or obj.Name:find("Verity") or obj.Name:find("Creature") then
                local hrp = obj:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or obj:FindFirstChild("Torso") or obj:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
                if hrp then
                    local box = Instance.new("BoxHandleAdornment")
                    box.Adornee = hrp
                    box.Size = obj:GetExtentsSize()
                    box.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
                    box.Transparency = 0.5
                    box.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    box.ZIndex = 0
                    box.Parent = hrp
                    game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(box, 0.1)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- IKON BULAT
local iconFrame = Instance.new("TextButton")
iconFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 50, 0, 50)
iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.9, 0, 0.2, 0)
iconFrame.Text = "Alo's"
iconFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 0, 0)
iconFrame.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
iconFrame.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
iconFrame.TextSize = 12
iconFrame.Visible = false
iconFrame.Parent = gui

local iconCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
iconCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
iconCorner.Parent = iconFrame

local dragging = false
local dragStart, startPos
iconFrame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true; dragStart = input.Position; startPos = iconFrame.Position
    end
end)
iconFrame.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        iconFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then dragging = false end
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() mainFrame.Visible = false; iconFrame.Visible = true end)
iconFrame.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() mainFrame.Visible = true; iconFrame.Visible = false end)

RunService.Stepped:Connect(function() if noclipActive then noclip() end end)

-- NOTIFIKASI AWAL
game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
    Title = "TIP",
    Text = "Teleports not working? Try Spam click the safe spot button! Just trust me its will work ngl",
    Duration = 10
})
features:
[ FEATURES ]
- Safe Spots (Teleport bypass anti-cheat)
- The House (3 Locations)
- Snowbound (2 Locations)
- StormChast (2 Locations)
- Locust ESP (WIP)
- No Fog (Extreme)
- Fullbright
- Noclip
- Draggable UI
